description.content: Create, list, read, update, and delete forms, fields, and submissions.
The forms endpoint returns information about the forms. The response includes submissions and other details about each form.

info.name: 123FormBuilder REST API v2 Accounts Forms API

description.content:
REST API v2 for 123FormBuilder. Manage forms, retrieve and update submissions, list fields, administer users, groups, and accounts. Authenticate by exchanging credentials at /token for a JWT, then pass the token on subsequent requests.
